groups.rationale: Catch-all sources: susan/ gains the WNS provider (Entra ID client credentials, raw notifications, channel URIs admitted only under susan-wns-channel-shape, provider code 3, wns_app_ids and WNS_* secrets); mila/ gains macOS and Windows runners, darwin/Shared Swift, platform profile, Windows owner-only DACL storage and mila/tool. Chapters 08, 11, 20, 21 and 22 updated; the WNS path is undeployed and its gaps are named in 20-security and the susan-wns-egress scenario.

Adds the test-only FreeBSD GENERIC-OVERALLS-FAULT kernel (ovfb_fault.h appended only in the fault build; production recipe asserts the injection symbol is absent), the transport probe's --require-fault-injection wrong-CID phase, and the native-freebsd-wrong-cid machine test, which passed under nested KVM/Firecracker (receipt a854e30e). Chapters 07 and 20, the scenario ledger and chapter 19 record FreeBSD-only kernel wrong-CID refusal; OmniOS, DMA, reset-race and isolation remain gaps. Also covers the Lilly Android display firewall, the DisplayHostBridgeTest correction and editor broker sd_notify readiness.

Only shared HLDD chapters 07, 08, 19 and 20 and the native attestation scenario changed (FreeBSD wrong-CID fault-kernel evidence, Android display firewall, editor broker readiness); no source in this group changed.
